text: I stand is when guys ask me out on a coffee day or ask me to go do a workout. It's like, no, I can take myself to coffee. I can also take myself to work out. You can also take yourself to a restaurant or to any other place, can't you? Guys, you need to understand one simple rule in dating. Simplify, don't complicate. If a girl has a long list of demands just to see you, you need to get her a taxi, you have to take her only to certain restaurants, you need to bring flowers or gifts on a very first date, stay away from her. That's not dating, that's running errands for someone who doesn't even know you yet. A coffee date or grabbing a drink at a bar is a perfectly normal first date. It's not about the coffee, it's not about a cocktail. It's about spending time together, talking and seeing if there's chemistry. That's what matters. And here's the real point. If you as you are, your presence, your vibe, your personality is not enough for her to show up and meet you, then forget it. Don't bend over backwards for someone who sees you as a wallet or a checklist. Just go meet another woman who will value you for who you are, not for what you can buy on a first date. Bottom line, dating should be simple. If she makes it complicated before you even know each other, that's already a red flag. Move on.
